statement.zh: 南宋医家王执中历时十余年编撰的《针灸资生经》7卷在临安（今杭州）刊印。该书总结了宋代以前针灸学的成就，收录了365个穴位，详细记载了各穴位的定位、主治病症以及灸法操作，并特别强调了穴位按压的临床经验。这部著作对后世针灸学发展产生了重要影响，至今仍是中医针灸的重要参考文献。
statement.en:
The 7 volume 'Zhenjiu Zisheng Jing' (Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion for Life Nourishment), compiled by the Song physician Wang Zhizhong over more than a decade, was printed in Lin'an (present-day Hangzhou). The work summarized pre-Song achievements in acupuncture, recording 365 acupoints with detailed information on location, indications, moxibustion techniques, and emphasized clinical experience with point pressure. This classic significantly influenced later acupuncture development and remains an important reference in TCM.

For Asia in 1201, “Southern Song prints 'Zhenjiu Zisheng Jing'” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: The Italian mathematician Fibonacci, in Liber Abaci, systematically presented Hindu-Arabic numerals and zero, reforming European arithmetic.

statement.zh:
意大利数学家斐波那契在《算盘书》中系统介绍印度—阿拉伯数字与零，推动欧洲算术革新。书中以商用算题为线索，演示十进位记数、分数与比例的计算，并用零与位值简化了此前的算盘与罗马数字运算。新的记数法便于记账、换算与借贷，逐渐被商人与学者采用。

把「斐波那契引入阿拉伯数字」放回1202年的意大利，可以看到科学变化的一个具体切面。

statement.en:
The Fourth Crusade clashed with Alexios V, son of the deposed Alexios III. On 12 April 1204 the crusaders launched a general assault, broke through the walls of Constantinople, and then sacked the ancient city for three days, looting countless precious artifacts and religious relics, including the bronze doors and golden statues of Hagia Sophia. The Byzantine Empire was overthrown, and the crusaders established the Latin Empire (1204-1261). The sack caused an irreparable rift between the Eastern and Western churches and permanently weakened Byzantium as the eastern bulwark of Christendom.

For Europe in 1204, “Crusaders sack Constantinople” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
Begun in 1163 under Bishop Maurice de Sully, Notre-Dame de Paris saw its choir, transepts and nave completed and brought into use by about 1205, when work started on the west front. Over the following decades came the three deeply recessed portals - of the Last Judgement, of the Virgin and of St Anne - the Gallery of Kings with its 28 statues of the kings of Judah, and the west rose window nearly ten metres across; the twin towers were topped out only around 1240-1250, and the spires of the original design were never built. The nave rises more than 32 metres, and the flying buttresses added in the thirteenth century to brace its walls span remarkable distances, making the church, with its vast clerestory, a model of High Gothic architecture.

statement.zh: 公元1207年，成吉思汗派长子术赤率蒙古军征服了西伯利亚南部的吉利吉思部（吉尔吉斯人祖先）。吉利吉思部居住在叶尼塞河上游地区，以游牧和狩猎为生。术赤大军压境后，吉利吉思首领不战而降，向成吉思汗进贡白鹰等珍贵礼物。此战是蒙古帝国向西北扩张的重要一步，为后来征服西伯利亚森林部落和打通通向中亚的商路奠定了基础。
statement.en:
In 1207, Genghis Khan sent his eldest son Jochi with a Mongol army to conquer the Kirghiz tribes (ancestors of the Kyrgyz people) living in the upper Yenisei River region, who lived by nomadism and hunting. When Jochi's army approached, the Kirghiz chief surrendered without a fight, offering white falcons and other precious gifts to Genghis Khan. This campaign was an important step in the Mongol Empire's northwest expansion, laying the foundation for later conquests of Siberian forest tribes and opening the trade route to Central Asia.

For Asia in 1207, “Mongols conquer the Kirghiz tribes” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 南宋在史弥远主导下与金朝签订和约：南宋向金岁币由银20万两、绢20万匹增至银30万两、绢30万匹，另付犒军银300万两；金朝从占领的南宋领土撤军，双方改为伯侄之国（金为伯，宋为侄）。同时，南宋将韩侂胄、苏师旦的首级送交金朝。嘉定和议进一步加重了南宋的财政负担，但换来了十余年的相对和平。
statement.en:
Under Shi Miyuan, the Southern Song concluded a peace treaty with the Jin: the annual Song tribute of 200,000 taels of silver and 200,000 bolts of silk was increased to 300,000 each, plus an indemnity of 3 million taels of silver; the Jin withdrew from occupied Song territory; the 2 states changed their relationship to uncle-nephew (Jin as uncle, Song as nephew). The Song also sent the heads of Han Tuozhou and Su Shidan to the Jin. The Treaty of Jiading further burdened the Southern Song's finances but gave over a decade of relative peace.

For Asia in 1208, “Treaty of Jiading signed” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en: From 1206 Dominic preached against the Cathars in Languedoc through poverty and argument and founded a convent at Prouille; this mission led to the Order of Preachers, formed at Toulouse in 1215 and papally approved in 1216.

sources.locator: Section “Early life and career” and article summary
sources.excerpt: In 1206 the papal legates and preachers, depressed at the failure of their mission, consulted the bishop and Dominic, who reasoned that the heretics would be regained only by an austerity equal to their own; the preachers must tramp the roads barefoot and in poverty. He formed the order in Toulouse (France) in 1215, and it received papal approval in 1216.

note.zh: 来源记多明我1206年起以清贫与说理在朗格多克对抗卡特里派、在普鲁伊建女修院，1215年在图卢兹成立修会、1216年获教皇批准；正文所记1209年阿尔比十字军、1215年出席第四次拉特兰公会议、日后宗教裁判所与托马斯·阿奎那等细节来源未在同段逐项支持，claim 不写1209年十字军与后续机构。

statement.zh: 蒙古军在征伐中亚过程中大量俘获穆斯林工匠，其中一些人掌握了配重式投石机（又称“回回炮”或“重力投石机”）的制造技术。1210年前后，这些工匠的技术逐渐传入南宋边境。相比南宋传统的扭力投石机，回回炮能投射更重的石弹且射程更远，此后的宋蒙战争中成为攻城利器，在1273年襄樊战役中发挥了决定性作用。
statement.en:
During their conquest of Central Asia, the Mongols captured many Muslim artisans, some of whom knew how to make counterweight trebuchets (called 'huihuipao' or 'Muslim trebuchet'). Around 1210, this technology began to reach the Southern Song border. Compared to the traditional torsion trebuchets, the counterweight trebuchet could throw heavier stones over longer distances. It became a crucial siege weapon in the subsequent Song-Mongol wars, playing a decisive role in the 1273 battle of Xiangyang-Fancheng.

For Asia in 1210, “Counterweight trebuchet reaches Southern Song” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 成吉思汗在征服乃蛮部时俘虏了掌印官塔塔统阿，命他以回鹘字母为基础创制蒙古文字。塔塔统阿将回鹘文的22个字母稍加改动，使之适合蒙古语的发音特点，并于1210年左右完成了蒙古文字的创制。这种回鹘式蒙古文成为蒙古帝国的官方文字，用于书写法令、史书和信件，后经过改良一直沿用至今，是现代蒙古文的前身。
statement.en:
When Genghis Khan conquered the Naiman tribe, he captured their seal keeper, Tata-tonga, and ordered him to create a script for the Mongols based on the Uyghur alphabet. Tata-tonga slightly modified the 22 letters of the Uyghur script to suit the phonetic features of the Mongolian language, completing the task around 1210. This Uyghur-based script became the official script of the Mongol Empire, used for decrees, histories, and letters. After further modifications, it has survived to the present day as the precursor of modern Mongolian script.

For Asia in 1210, “Creation of the Mongolian script” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 成吉思汗亲率大军再次南攻金朝，从居庸关突破长城防线，直逼金中都（今北京）。由于金军死守城池，蒙古军缺乏攻城器械，围城数月未克。成吉思汗遂分兵扫荡河北、山东、山西等地，攻陷了除中都、真定、大名等少数坚城外的几乎所有州县。蒙古军在华北平原上实行焦土政策，大量农田被毁，百姓死亡枕藉，金朝的北方经济基础遭到毁灭性打击。
statement.en:
Genghis Khan again led his army south against the Jin, breaking through the Great Wall at Juyong Pass and directly threatening Zhongdu (present-day Beijing). The Jin defenders held out; the Mongols lacked siege equipment, so after months of unsuccessful siege, Genghis Khan dispatched troops to pillage Hebei, Shandong, and Shanxi, capturing almost all prefectures and counties except Zhongdu, Zhengding, and Daming. The Mongols implemented a scorched-earth policy on the North China Plain, destroying vast amounts of farmland and causing immense loss of life, devastating the Jin's northern economic base.

For Asia in 1212, “Second Mongol siege of Zhongdu” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

The Mongols implemented a scorched-earth policy on the North China Plain, destroying vast amounts of farmland and causing immense loss of life, devastating the Jin's northern economic base.

summary.en: Under military pressure from the Mongols and political crisis, Emperor Weishao of Jin was killed by the powerful minister Hushahu. title.en: Jin Xuanzong moves capital to Bianjing

summary.en: Faced with continued Mongol siege and internal political crisis, Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, over the objections of senior ministers such as Tushan Yi, announced in May 1214 the transfer of the capital from Zhongdu (present-day Beijing) to Bianjing (present-day Kaifeng, Henan). The move used 32,000 carts to transport court valuables and archives, with 70,000 troops escorting the s

statement.zh: 面对蒙古军的持续围困和金朝内部的政治危机，金宣宗不顾徒单镒等重臣的反对，于1214年5月宣布将都城从中都（今北京）迁往汴京（今河南开封）。
statement.en: Faced with continued Mongol siege and internal political crisis, Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, over the objections of senior ministers such as Tushan Yi, announced in May 1214 the transfer of the capital from Zhongdu (present-day Beijing) to Bianjing (present-day Kaifeng, Henan).

zh: 面对蒙古军的持续围困和金朝内部的政治危机，金宣宗不顾徒单镒等重臣的反对，于1214年5月宣布将都城从中都（今北京）迁往汴京（今河南开封）。
en: Faced with continued Mongol siege and internal political crisis, Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, over the objections of senior ministers such as Tushan Yi, announced in May 1214 the transfer of the capital from Zhongdu (present-day Beijing) to Bianjing (present-day Kaifeng, Henan).

statement.zh: 内容包括：未经全国公意不得征税；任何自由人未经合法审判不得逮捕、监禁或剥夺财产；伦敦等城市享有自治权；教会享有选举自由等。
statement.en: The document, known as Magna Carta, included provisions such as: no taxation without common consent of the realm; no free man could be arrested, imprisoned, or dispossessed except by lawful judgment; cities like London had the right to self-government; the church had freedom of elections.

en: The document, known as Magna Carta, included provisions such as: no taxation without common consent of the realm; no free man could be arrested, imprisoned, or dispossessed except by lawful judgment; cities like London had the right to self-government; the church had freedom of elections.

summary.en: Pope Honorius III called for the Fifth Crusade at a council in the Lateran Palace. Unlike previous crusades, the target was the Egyptian port of Damietta; the pope believed that only by destroying Egypt, the economic lifeline of the Ayyubid dynasty, could Jerusalem be recovered. Duke Leopold VI of Austria and King Andrew II of Hungary responded, assembling their armies at Acre.

statement.zh: 蒙古西征军分四路进攻花剌子模，察合台和窝阔台率军围攻锡尔河畔的战略重镇讹答剌。该城守将亦纳勒术（曾杀害蒙古商队）率领五万守军坚守五个月。蒙古军使用回回炮日夜轰击城墙，最终于1220年2月破城。亦纳勒术被俘后被熔化银液灌入眼睛和耳朵处死。讹答剌之战的惨烈程度震慑了整个中亚。
statement.en:
The Mongol western army attacked Khwarazm in four columns. Chagatai and Ögedei besieged Otrar, a strategic city on the Syr Darya. The commander Inalchuq (who had killed the Mongol trade caravan) defended with 50,000 men for five months. The Mongols used counterweight trebuchets day and night, finally breaching the walls in February 1220. Inalchuq was captured and executed by having molten silver poured into his eyes and ears. The brutality of the siege shocked all of Central Asia.

For Asia in 1219, “Mongols capture Otrar” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh:
泰族首领膺它沙罗铁联合周边部落，在高棉帝国的吴哥王朝控制下宣布独立，建立素可泰王国（意为“幸福的黎明”），定都素可泰城（今泰国素可泰府）。膺它沙罗铁采用“父权制”统治方式，强调国王是人民的父亲而非神。素可泰王国是泰国历史上第一个独立王国，被视为泰国文明的发源地，其统治时期的艺术和建筑（如行走佛造像）成为泰国文化的象征。

1220年的素可泰王国，「素可泰王国建立」属于政治领域。
statement.en:
The Thai chief Pho Khun Sri Indraditya, together with neighboring tribes, declared independence from the Khmer Empire's Angkor dynasty, establishing the Sukhothai Kingdom (meaning 'Dawn of Happiness') with its capital at Sukhothai (present-day Sukhothai province, Thailand). Sri Indraditya adopted a 'paternal' style of rule, emphasizing that the king was the father of the people rather than a god. Sukhothai was the first independent Thai kingdom and is considered the cradle of Thai civilization. Its art and architecture (such as the walking Buddha statues) became symbols of Thai culture.

In 1220, “Foundation of the Sukhothai Kingdom” belongs to the field of Politics in Asia.

For Asia in 1220, “Foundation of the Sukhothai Kingdom” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 花剌子模王子札兰丁在成吉思汗大军压境的情况下逃往阿富汗地区，并集结了约6万残部，在八鲁湾（今阿富汗喀布尔北部）设伏。蒙古大将失吉忽秃忽率3万骑兵追击，因地形不利被札兰丁击败，蒙古军死伤过半。这是蒙古西征以来遭受的最大败仗。成吉思汗闻讯后亲率大军前往，在印度河畔彻底击溃札兰丁，后者只身逃往印度。
statement.en:
Khwarazmian prince Jalal al-Din, with the Mongol army approaching, fled to Afghanistan and rallied about 60,000 survivors. He set an ambush at Parwan (north of present-day Kabul, Afghanistan). The Mongol general Shigi Qutuqu pursued with 30,000 cavalry but was defeated due to unfavorable terrain, losing over half his force. This was the worst defeat the Mongols suffered during the western campaign. Upon hearing the news, Genghis Khan led his main army to the Indus River, where he crushed Jalal al-Din, who escaped alone to India.

For Asia in 1221, “Battle of Parwan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: First general chapter of the Franciscans

summary.en: In 1223, Saint Francis of Assisi held the first general chapter of the Franciscan Order at the Porziuncola near Assisi, attended by about 5,000 friars. title.en: Genghis Khan returns to Mongolia after western campaign

summary.en: After six years of western campaigning, Genghis Khan left small garrison forces in the newly conquered Central Asian territories and led his main army eastward back to the Mongolian plateau. On the way, he received news that Western Xia had rebelled and was trying to ally with the Jin against the Mongols. Thus he decided to launch a war against Western Xia immediately upon his

statement.zh: 在经过六年的西征后，成吉思汗留下少量驻屯军镇守新征服的中亚地区，自己率领主力部队东返蒙古草原。他在路上接到了西夏反叛和联络金朝共同抗蒙的消息，因此决定回国后立即发动对西夏的战争。成吉思汗的西征使蒙古帝国的版图从太平洋延伸至里海。
statement.en:
After six years of western campaigning, Genghis Khan left small garrison forces in the newly conquered Central Asian territories and led his main army eastward back to the Mongolian plateau. On the way, he received news that Western Xia had rebelled and was trying to ally with the Jin against the Mongols. Thus he decided to launch a war against Western Xia immediately upon his return. Genghis Khan's western campaign expanded the Mongol Empire from the Pacific to the Caspian Sea.

For Asia in 1224, “Genghis Khan returns to Mongolia after western campaign” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II launches Sixth Crusade

summary.en: In 1227, Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II formally launched the Sixth Crusade. He was excommunicated by Pope Gregory IX after falling ill and returning home. In 1228 he nevertheless set out for the Holy Land. Through diplomatic negotiations rather than military action, he recovered Jerusalem, Bethlehem, and Nazareth from the Egyptian sultan.

summary.en: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II, despite being under excommunication by Pope Gregory IX, led the Sixth Crusade eastward. Instead of fighting, he engaged in diplomatic negotiations with the Ayyubid Sultan al-Kamil, culminating in the Treaty of Jaffa: the Muslims returned Jerusalem, Bethlehem, and Nazareth to Christian control, but retained the Dome of the Rock and the Al-Aqsa Mo

statement.zh: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世在教皇格列高利九世的绝罚令下，依然率领十字军东征。
statement.en: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II, despite being under excommunication by Pope Gregory IX, led the Sixth Crusade eastward.

zh: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世在教皇格列高利九世的绝罚令下，依然率领十字军东征。

statement.zh: 他通过与阿尤布王朝苏丹卡米勒进行外交谈判，而不是武力作战，达成了《雅法条约》：穆斯林将耶路撒冷、伯利恒和拿撒勒归还基督徒，但保留圣殿山上的岩石圆顶清真寺和阿克萨清真寺，且基督徒不得在耶路撒冷修筑城墙。
statement.en: Instead of fighting, he engaged in diplomatic negotiations with the Ayyubid Sultan al-Kamil, culminating in the Treaty of Jaffa: the Muslims returned Jerusalem, Bethlehem, and Nazareth to Christian control, but retained the Dome of the Rock and the Al-Aqsa Mosque on the Temple Mount, and Christians were not allowed to refortify Jerusalem.

zh: 他通过与阿尤布王朝苏丹卡米勒进行外交谈判，而不是武力作战，达成了《雅法条约》：穆斯林将耶路撒冷、伯利恒和拿撒勒归还基督徒，但保留圣殿山上的岩石圆顶清真寺和阿克萨清真寺，且基督徒不得在耶路撒冷修筑城墙。
en: Instead of fighting, he engaged in diplomatic negotiations with the Ayyubid Sultan al-Kamil, culminating in the Treaty of Jaffa: the Muslims returned Jerusalem, Bethlehem, and Nazareth to Christian control, but retained the Dome of the Rock and the Al-Aqsa Mosque on the Temple Mount, and Christians were not allowed to refortify Jerusalem.

summary.en: Pope Gregory IX approved the founding of the University of Toulouse to promote orthodox doctrine in the Languedoc region where Albigensian heresy had been rampant. The university had faculties of theology, canon law, and arts, primarily training missionaries and judges. It was the oldest university in southern France and played an important role in suppressing Catharism.

statement.zh:
教皇格列高利九世为了在阿尔比派异端盛行的朗格多克地区推广正统教义，批准成立了图卢兹大学。大学设有神学、教会法和文学院，主要培养传教士和法官。这是法国南部最古老的大学，在镇压卡特里派异端的过程中发挥了重要作用。

1229年的法国，「图卢兹大学成立」属于教育领域。

summary.en: In 1229, King James I of Aragon landed on Mallorca and, after months of siege, captured the Muslim-held city of Mallorca. In 1235 Aragon conquered Ibiza. The Balearic Islands became part of the Crown of Aragon and served as an important transit point for Mediterranean trade.

statement.zh:
公元1229年，阿拉贡国王海梅一世（Jaime I）率军从马略卡岛登陆，经过数月围攻攻占了穆斯林控制的马略卡城。1235年阿拉贡又征服了伊维萨岛。巴利阿里群岛并入阿拉贡王国后成为地中海贸易的重要中转站。

1229年的阿拉贡王国，「阿拉贡征服巴利阿里群岛」属于军事领域。

title.en: Teutonic Knights establish vassalage over Prussia

summary.en: The Grand Master of the Teutonic Order, Hermann von Salza, concluded a treaty with Prussian tribal leaders, under which the Prussians nominally submitted to the Order and provided labor and tribute. This marked the beginning of the Order's colonial rule in Prussia. Over the following decades, through conquest and immigration, the Order thoroughly Germanized Prussia.

statement.zh:
条顿骑士团大团长赫尔曼·冯·萨尔扎与普鲁士当地部落首领签订条约，普鲁士名义上臣服于骑士团，并向骑士团提供劳役和贡品。这标志着条顿骑士团在普鲁士地区的殖民统治开始建立。此后数十年间，骑士团通过武力征服和移民，将普鲁士彻底德意志化。

summary.en: The medieval church formalized indulgences, by which penance could be commuted by deeds or gifts — later a trigger of the Reformation.

statement.zh: 中世纪教会将赎罪券制度化，信徒以善功或捐献抵消罪罚，后成宗教改革导火索。赎罪券把悔罪与捐献联系起来，逐渐演变为可交易的形式；其商业化在后期引发对教会权力与救赎观的质疑，成为宗教改革的直接导火索之一。这一制度也反映出中世纪教会如何把精神权威转化为社会与财政资源。
statement.en: In the Middle Ages, the church institutionalized indulgences, in which believers used good deeds or donations to offset sins and punishments, which later became the trigger for the religious reform.

title.en: Ögedei devises plan to destroy Jin

summary.en: Ögedei convened a military council at Karakorum and drew up the final plan to destroy the Jin: a three-pronged attack, with the central army led by Ögedei himself against Kaifeng, the left army under Öchigin against Shandong, and the right army under Tolui passing through the Southern Song's Hanzhong region to fall on the Jin rear. Tolui sent envoys to the Song requesting passa

statement.en: Ögedei convened a military council at Karakorum and drew up the final plan to destroy the Jin: a three-pronged attack, with the central army led by Ögedei himself against Kaifeng, the left army under Öchigin against Shandong, and the right army under Tolui passing through the Southern Song's Hanzhong region to fall on the Jin rear.

en: Ögedei convened a military council at Karakorum and drew up the final plan to destroy the Jin: a three-pronged attack, with the central army led by Ögedei himself against Kaifeng, the left army under Öchigin against Shandong, and the right army under Tolui passing through the Southern Song's Hanzhong region to fall on the Jin rear.

statement.en: Using the killing of the Mongol envoy Chu-ku-yu on Korean soil some years earlier as his pretext, Ogedei sent Sartai across the Yalu to invade Goryeo.

zh: 窝阔台以蒙古使臣著古与数年前在高丽境内被杀为由，命撒礼塔率军渡鸭绿江东征。
en: Using the killing of the Mongol envoy Chu-ku-yu on Korean soil some years earlier as his pretext, Ogedei sent Sartai across the Yalu to invade Goryeo.

statement.zh: 蒙军连破咸新镇、铁州，铁州守将力战半月城陷，阖城自焚死难；麟州人洪福源率一千五百户降蒙，转为蒙军向导。
statement.en: The Mongols stormed Hamsinjin and Cheolju, whose garrison fought for half a month before the city fell and its people burned themselves rather than surrender; Hong Bok-won of Injun went over to the Mongols with fifteen hundred households and served as their guide.

zh: 蒙军连破咸新镇、铁州，铁州守将力战半月城陷，阖城自焚死难；麟州人洪福源率一千五百户降蒙，转为蒙军向导。
en: The Mongols stormed Hamsinjin and Cheolju, whose garrison fought for half a month before the city fell and its people burned themselves rather than surrender; Hong Bok-won of Injun went over to the Mongols with fifteen hundred households and served as their guide.

statement.zh: 唯龟州守将朴犀、金庆孙婴城拒守月余，蒙军以云梯、楼车、火攻百计攻之而终不能下，只得绕城南进，围逼开京。
statement.en: Only at Kwiju did the defenders Pak Sŏ and Kim Kyong-son hold out, repelling siege ladders, assault towers and fire attacks for more than a month until the Mongols gave up and bypassed the city to press on towards Kaegyeong.

statement.en: The following year the military ruler Choe U removed King Gojong to Ganghwa Island, beyond the reach of cavalry, and had the darughachi killed or driven out, bringing the Mongols back.

title.en: The Kamakura shogunate promulgates the Goseibai Shikimoku

summary.en: In 1232 Hojo Yasutoki, third regent of the Kamakura shogunate, together with the council of state issued the fifty-one articles of the Goseibai Shikimoku, the first written law code of the Japanese warrior class. Rather than citing the imperial codes or Chinese precedent, it rested on established practice since Minamoto no Yoritomo and on the 'reason' of warrior society, defini

statement.zh: 贞永元年（1232年），镰仓幕府第三代执权北条泰时会同评定众制定并颁布《御成败式目》（又称《贞永式目》）51条，是日本第一部武家成文法典。它不援引律令与汉籍典故，而以源赖朝以来的"先例"和武士社会的"道理"为准绳，规定守护与地头的职权界限、御家人所领的继承与买卖、二十年知行时效以及诉讼程序，并明文承认女性的领地继承权与养子权。式目文字浅近、便于地方武士援用，公家法与庄园法则仍并行于各自领域。此后历代武家法典多以其为蓝本，影响直至江户时代。
statement.en:
In 1232 Hojo Yasutoki, third regent of the Kamakura shogunate, together with the council of state issued the 51 articles of the Goseibai Shikimoku, the first written law code of the Japanese warrior class. Rather than citing the imperial codes or Chinese precedent, it rested on established practice since Minamoto no Yoritomo and on the 'reason' of warrior society, defining the powers of provincial constables and estate stewards, the inheritance and sale of vassals' holdings, a twenty-year rule of prescription and the conduct of lawsuits, and expressly recognising a woman's right to inherit land and adopt an heir. Written in plain language for use by provincial warriors, it left court law and estate law in force in their own spheres, and served as the model for later warrior codes down to the Edo period.

For Asia in 1232, “The Kamakura shogunate promulgates the Goseibai Shikimoku” is a traceable node of Law change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Goryeo Court Flees to Ganghwa Island

summary.en: The military ruler Choe U moved the court offshore to Ganghwa, exploiting Mongol weakness at sea for nearly forty years while the mainland suffered.

statement.zh: 武臣执政崔瑀挟王室渡海入江华岛，凭蒙古不习水战之短据守近40年，本土百姓则饱受兵燹。海岛都城以城墙与港湾设防，朝廷在此维持文书、礼仪与外交，形成与大陆不同的战时体制；长期据守使王朝得以延续，代价是陆地上的征发与破坏。迁都的选择把军事上的取舍转化为对民众的沉重负担。
statement.en:
The military minister Cui Yu took the royal family across the sea to Ganghwa Island, and held it for nearly 40 years due to Mongolia's lack of experience in water warfare. The local people suffered a lot from the war. The island capital was fortified with city walls and harbors, and the court maintained documents, etiquette, and diplomacy here, forming a wartime system that was different from that on the mainland. Long-term defense allowed the dynasty to continue, at the cost of conquest and destruction on land. The choice to move the capital turned military trade-offs into a heavy burden on the people.

It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Goryeo and politics history.

statement.zh: 蒙古军围攻汴京时，金守军以“震天雷”御敌：生铁铸壳内实火药，点燃后自城上抛下或以炮机发射。《金史》称其“火药发作，声如雷震，闻100里外，所爇围半亩之上”，铁片可透重甲，是文献所记最早的爆炸性铁壳火器之一。
statement.en:
During the Mongol siege of Kaifeng the Jin defenders used the 'heaven-shaking thunder': gunpowder packed in a cast-iron casing, lit and dropped from the walls or hurled by trebuchet. The History of Jin records that 'when the powder went off the noise was like thunder, heard a hundred li away, and it scorched more than half a mu', while the fragments could pierce heavy armour - among the earliest documented explosive iron-cased weapons.

For Asia in 1232, “Jin uses thunder crash bombs” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

公元1233年，穆瓦希德王朝（Almohad Caliphate）的军队在西班牙南部的萨莱（Salé）附近与卡斯蒂利亚王国联军发生激战。穆瓦希德王朝在1212年拉斯纳瓦斯德托洛萨战役惨败后已极度衰弱，内部各派争权夺利。萨莱战役的失败标志着穆瓦希德王朝在伊比利亚半岛的统治彻底崩溃，基督教王国开始全面收复失地。1248年卡斯蒂利亚攻占塞维利亚，穆瓦希德在北非的残余势力也迅速瓦解。

statement.zh: 窝阔台与南宋联兵围攻金人最后据点蔡州，正月城破，金哀宗完颜守绪自缢，仓促继位的末帝完颜承麟死于乱军，立国一百二十年的金朝灭亡。此后蒙宋隔河南直接对峙，南宋随即“端平入洛”意图收复三京而失败，宋蒙战争由此开启。
statement.en:
Ogedei's forces, joined by the Southern Song, besieged Caizhou, the last Jin stronghold. The city fell in the first month; Emperor Aizong hanged himself and his hastily enthroned successor Wanyan Chenglin died in the fighting, ending the Jin dynasty after 120 years. Mongols and Song now faced each other directly across Henan, and the Song's failed 'Duanping' bid to retake the three capitals soon opened the long Song-Mongol war.

For Asia in 1234, “Mongol conquest of Jin” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: After the fall of the Jin, the former Song chancellor Shi Miyuan had died, and Emperor Lizong assumed personal rule. He decided to take advantage of the Mongol main force's withdrawal north to recover the old Song capitals: Kaifeng (Eastern Capital), Luoyang (Western Capital), and Yingtian (present-day Shangqiu, Henan). statement.zh: 金朝灭亡后，南宋权臣史弥远已死，宋理宗亲政，决定乘蒙古主力北撤之机，出兵收复北宋旧都东京开封府、西京洛阳和南京应天府（今河南商丘）。6月，宋将赵葵、全子才率军北进，几乎兵不血刃进入开封和洛阳。然而蒙古军迅速回师，在洛阳城下大败宋军，宋军因粮草不济被迫南撤，损失惨重。端平入洛的失败使宋蒙关系破裂，蒙古以此为借口发动对南宋的战争。
statement.en:
After the fall of the Jin, the former Song chancellor Shi Miyuan had died, and Emperor Lizong assumed personal rule. He decided to take advantage of the Mongol main force's withdrawal north to recover the old Song capitals: Kaifeng (Eastern Capital), Luoyang (Western Capital), and Yingtian (present-day Shangqiu, Henan). In June, Song generals Zhao Kui and Quan Zicai led their troops north, entering Kaifeng and Luoyang almost without resistance. However, the Mongols quickly returned and heavily defeated the Song army at Luoyang; the Song forces, short of supplies, were forced to retreat south with heavy losses. The failure of the Duanping incursion ruptured Song-Mongol relations, and the Mongols used it as a pretext to launch war against the Southern Song.

For Asia in 1234, “Southern Song's Duanping entry into Luoyang” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
Batu's western expedition army reached the Volga River basin and captured Bulgar, the capital of the Bulgars (present-day Republic of Tatarstan, Russia). The Mongols destroyed the city's palaces, mosques, and libraries, and massacred a large part of the population. Volga Bulgaria, a state that had existed for centuries (c. 660-1236), was destroyed, and its territory incorporated into the Golden Horde.

For Europe in 1236, “Mongols capture Volga Bulgaria” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: After the first set burned in the Mongol wars, Goryeo spent sixteen years cutting over eighty thousand woodblocks, the most complete Buddhist canon in Chinese.

statement.zh:
初雕藏经毁于蒙古兵火后，高丽倾国力于江华重刻，历16年成八万余块经版，为现存最完整的汉文大藏经。刻板选材严整，校勘与书写由僧侣与官员分工，经版存放于寺院，兼具信仰与护国之愿。后世以此为底本刊印流通。

把「高丽开雕八万大藏经」放回1236年的高丽，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: After the original Tibetan Buddhist scriptures were destroyed by the Mongolian war, Goryeo devoted all its national power to re-engraving it in Jianghua. It took 16 years to produce more than 80,000 Buddhist scriptures, making it the most complete Chinese-language Tripitaka in existence. The materials are carefully selected, the collation and writing are divided between monks and officials, and the sutra editions are stored in temples, reflecting both faith and the desire to protect the country. Later generations used this as a basis for publication and circulation. If we put "The Eighty Thousand Tripitakas of Goryeo were carved" back to Goryeo in 1236, we can see a specific aspect of religious changes.

title.en: The Alhambra is built in Granada

title.en: Thomas of Savoy becomes regent of Jerusalem

summary.en: In 1239, Count Thomas I of Savoy became regent of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, one of the crusader states in the Levant. Thomas tried to coordinate the various crusader factions against the rising Mamluk threat from Egypt. However, internal divisions among the crusaders prevented effective resistance.

In 1239, Count Thomas I of Savoy became regent of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, one of the crusader states in the Levant. statement.zh: 公元1243年，蒙古帝国大将拜住那颜率军入侵安纳托利亚，在科塞达格战役中大败罗姆苏丹国的塞尔柱军队后攻陷了埃尔祖鲁姆城。蒙古军焚毁城市、屠杀居民。埃尔祖鲁姆的陷落迫使罗姆苏丹向蒙古称臣纳贡，安纳托利亚东部和中部从此处于蒙古伊儿汗国的控制之下。
statement.en:
In 1243, the Mongol general Baiju Noyan invaded Anatolia, defeated the Seljuk army of the Sultanate of Rum at the Battle of Köse Dağ, and then captured the city of Erzurum. The Mongols burned the city and massacred the inhabitants. The fall of Erzurum forced the Sultanate of Rum to submit and pay tribute to the Mongols. Eastern and central Anatolia thus came under the control of the Ilkhanate.

title.en: Flourishing of Southern Song printing at Jianyang

summary.en: The printing workshops at Masha and Chonghua towns in Jianyang (present-day Nanping, Fujian) reached their peak. A total of 37 workshops were recorded, producing more than half of the nation's books. The Jianyang workshops specialized in popular literature, examination guides, and medical books, using cheap bamboo paper and woodblock printing, which greatly reduced book costs a

statement.zh: 福建建阳（今福建南平）的麻沙、崇化两镇书坊进入鼎盛时期，据统计共有37家书坊，刻印书籍数量占全国总量的一半以上。建阳书坊以刻印通俗读物、科举用书和医书著称，采用廉价的竹纸和木板印刷，大大降低了书籍成本，使普通士子也能买得起书。这一出版中心推动了宋代文化教育的普及。
statement.en:
The printing workshops at Masha and Chonghua towns in Jianyang (present-day Nanping, Fujian) reached their peak. A total of 37 workshops were recorded, producing more than half of the nation's books. The Jianyang workshops specialized in popular literature, examination guides, and medical books, using cheap bamboo paper and woodblock printing, which greatly reduced book costs and made them affordable to ordinary scholars. This publishing center promoted the spread of Song culture and education.

For Asia in 1245, “Flourishing of Southern Song printing at Jianyang” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Song Ci writes the Collected Accounts of Washing Away of Wrongs

summary.en: The Southern Song judge Song Ci compiled this forensic manual on autopsy and crime-scene examination, the world's earliest extant work of forensic medicine.

statement.zh: 南宋提刑官宋慈编撰《洗冤集录》，总结尸检与现场勘验，是世界现存最早的法医学专著。书中条列检验的顺序、伤痕的辨识与死因的推断，强调记录、复验与证据之间的对应；它把零散的办案经验整理成可传授的规程，供官府检验人员使用。此书在后世被不断增补与翻刻，影响远及东亚各地的司法实践。
statement.en: Song Ci, the criminal official of the Southern Song Dynasty, compiled "The Collection of Cleansing Wrongs", which summarizes autopsies and on-site investigations.

statement.zh: 南宋数学家秦9韶历时十年完成了数学巨著《数书9章》十八卷。该书系统论述了高次方程数值解法（正负开方术）、大衍求一术（一次同余方程组解法）以及各种测量、赋税、军旅中的应用数学问题。其中大衍求一术比欧洲高斯同余理论早500多年，正负开方术早于欧洲霍纳方法500多年。《数书9章》标志着中国古代数学达到了一个新的高峰。
statement.en:
The Song mathematician Qin Jiushao completed his magnum opus 'Shushu Jiuzhang' (Mathematical Treatise in 9 Sections) in 18 volumes after ten years of work. The treatise systematically discussed numerical solutions of higher-order equations (the zheng-fu kai fang method), the Dayan qiu yi method (solving simultaneous linear congruences), and applied problems in surveying, taxation, and military affairs. The Dayan qiu yi method predates Gauss's work on congruences by over 500 years, and the zheng-fu kai fang method predates Ruffini-Horner by more than 500 years. 'Shushu Jiuzhang' marked a new peak in ancient Chinese mathematics.

For Asia in 1247, “Qin Jiushao writes 'Shushu Jiuzhang'” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: King Louis IX of France launches Seventh Crusade

summary.en: The pious King Louis IX (Saint Louis), on hearing that Jerusalem had fallen again, vowed to launch a crusade to recover the Holy Land. He led 35,000 troops from France, assembled at Cyprus, and planned to attack Damietta in Egypt. This was the last major crusade led by a European monarch.

title.en: King Afonso III of Portugal conquers Algarve

summary.en: In 1249, King Afonso III of Portugal took Faro and the last remaining Moorish strongholds, completing the conquest of the Algarve. This marked the end of the Portuguese Reconquista and fixed Portugal's mainland borders, while touching off a decade-long dispute with Castile over sovereignty in the Algarve.

statement.zh:
公元1249年，葡萄牙国王阿方索三世攻取法鲁等最后几处摩尔人据点，完成了对阿尔加维地区的征服。这标志着葡萄牙收复失地运动（Reconquista）的完成，葡萄牙的大陆疆界自此基本确定，同时也引发了与卡斯蒂利亚长达十余年的阿尔加维归属之争。

title.en: Lübeck becomes leader of the Hanseatic League

summary.en: The North German city of Lübeck concluded a treaty with Hamburg to protect trade routes between the Baltic and the North Sea. This treaty is seen as the origin of the Hanseatic League. statement.zh: 公元1252年，蒙古大汗蒙哥命其弟忽必烈率领十万大军远征大理国（今云南）。忽必烈兵分三路，跨越川西高原和金沙江天险，于1253年攻破大理城，大理国王段兴智投降。蒙哥采用忽必烈建议，保留了段氏王族对大理地区的世袭统治权但派驻达鲁花赤监督。征服大理使蒙古获得了从西南攻击南宋的战略通道，也首次将云南纳入中央政权管辖。
statement.en:
In 1252, Great Khan Möngke ordered his brother Kublai to lead 100,000 troops on an expedition against the Dali kingdom (present-day Yunnan). Kublai divided his forces into three columns, crossed the Sichuan plateau and the Jinsha River, and captured Dali city in 1253. King Duan Xingzhi surrendered. Following Kublai's advice, Möngke allowed the Duan royal family to rule Dali hereditarily but stationed darughachis (overseers) there. The conquest of Dali gave the Mongols a strategic route to attack the Southern Song from the southwest and, for the first time, brought Yunnan under central government control.

For Asia in 1251, “Mongol campaign against Dali” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: First Venetian-Genoese War (War of St. Sabas)

summary.en: The two Italian maritime republics, Venice and Genoa, went to war over dominance of trade in the eastern Mediterranean. Venice allied with the Empire of Nicaea, obtaining trade privileges in Constantinople; Genoa allied with the Latin Empire. The fighting was concentrated in the Aegean and Black Seas, with heavy losses on both sides.

statement.zh:
威尼斯和热那亚两个意大利海上共和国因争夺地中海东部贸易霸权爆发战争。威尼斯与尼西亚帝国结盟，获得了君士坦丁堡的商业特权；热那亚则与拉丁帝国结盟。战争主要集中在爱琴海和黑海地区，双方均损失惨重。

1255年的威尼斯，「威尼斯—热那亚第一次战争（圣萨巴斯战争）」属于军事领域。

summary.en: Students at the University of Paris clashed with local citizens. Regent Blanche of Castile, mother of Louis IX, ordered a crackdown, resulting in several student deaths. The university faculty and students went on strike and threatened to move to Oxford or Cambridge. Pope Alexander IV mediated and eventually issued a charter confirming the university's judicial autonomy.

statement.zh:
巴黎大学学生与当地市民发生冲突，法国国王路易九世的摄政太后布朗歇下令镇压，导致数名学生死亡。巴黎大学师生罢课抗议，并威胁集体迁往牛津或剑桥。教皇亚历山大四世介入调解，最终向大学颁发特许状，确认大学的司法自治权。

title.en: Goryeo submits to the Mongols, ending the resistance from Ganghwa

summary.en: After six invasions had wrecked the country, Goryeo sent the crown prince Wang Jeon — the future King Wonjong — to the Mongols to offer submission. Mongke had just died before Diaoyu Fortress and the throne stood vacant; on the road the prince met Kublai returning north to claim it and attached himself to him first. Kublai was delighted, remarking that "Goryeo is a kingdom ten

statement.zh: 历六次征伐、举国残破之后，高丽遣太子王倎（后之元宗）赴蒙古请降。其时蒙哥方死于钓鱼城下，汗位空悬，太子于途中遇北返争位的忽必烈，遂率先归附。忽必烈大喜，谓"高丽万里之国，唐太宗亲征而不能服，今其世子自来归我，此天意也"，厚礼相待，并许"不改土风"，保全高丽衣冠、制度与王室宗庙。同年高宗去世，翌年太子归国即位。然武臣政权仍据江华岛不肯出陆，直至1270年林惟茂被诛、自崔忠献以来100年武人之政彻底终结，高丽方还都开京；不服者别组三别抄。转战珍岛、耽罗（济州），抗争至1273年始平。此后高丽历代国王皆尚元朝公主，成为元之驸马之国，历100年而后已。
statement.en: After six invasions had wrecked the country, Goryeo sent the crown prince Wang Jeon — the future King Wonjong — to the Mongols to offer submission. Mongke had just died before Diaoyu Fortress and the throne stood vacant; on the road the prince met Kublai returning north to claim it and attached himself to him first. Kublai was delighted, remarking that "Goryeo is a kingdom 10,000 li away that even Emperor Taizong of Tang could not subdue by his own campaign, and now its heir comes to me of his own accord — this is the will of Heaven." He received him with honour and granted that Goryeo might "keep its own customs unchanged", preserving its dress, institutions and royal ancestral shrines. Gojong died that same year and the prince returned to take the throne in 1260. The military rulers still refused to leave Ganghwa, however, and only in 1270, when Im Yu-mu was killed and the century of generals that began with Choe Chung-heon finally ended, did the court return to Kaegyeong; the irreconcilable Sambyeolcho fought on from Jindo and Tamna (Jeju) until 1273. Thereafter every Goryeo king married a Yuan princess, and for a hundred years the kingdom was a son-in-law state of the Mongol empire.

zh: 历六次征伐、举国残破之后，高丽遣太子王倎（后之元宗）赴蒙古请降。其时蒙哥方死于钓鱼城下，汗位空悬，太子于途中遇北返争位的忽必烈，遂率先归附。忽必烈大喜，谓"高丽万里之国，唐太宗亲征而不能服，今其世子自来归我，此天意也"，厚礼相待，并许"不改土风"，保全高丽衣冠、制度与王室宗庙。同年高宗去世，翌年太子归国即位。然武臣政权仍据江华岛不肯出陆，直至1270年林惟茂被诛、自崔忠献以来100年武人之政彻底终结，高丽方还都开京；不服者别组三别抄。转战珍岛、耽罗（济州），抗争至1273年始平。此后高丽历代国王皆尚元朝公主，成为元之驸马之国，历100年而后已。
en: After six invasions had wrecked the country, Goryeo sent the crown prince Wang Jeon — the future King Wonjong — to the Mongols to offer submission. Mongke had just died before Diaoyu Fortress and the throne stood vacant; on the road the prince met Kublai returning north to claim it and attached himself to him first. Kublai was delighted, remarking that "Goryeo is a kingdom 10,000 li away that even Emperor Taizong of Tang could not subdue by his own campaign, and now its heir comes to me of his own accord — this is the will of Heaven." He received him with honour and granted that Goryeo might "keep its own customs unchanged", preserving its dress, institutions and royal ancestral shrines. Gojong died that same year and the prince returned to take the throne in 1260. The military rulers still refused to leave Ganghwa, however, and only in 1270, when Im Yu-mu was killed and the century of generals that began with Choe Chung-heon finally ended, did the court return to Kaegyeong; the irreconcilable Sambyeolcho fought on from Jindo and Tamna (Jeju) until 1273. Thereafter every Goryeo king married a Yuan princess, and for a hundred years the kingdom was a son-in-law state of the Mongol empire.

title.en: Treaty of Paris between Louis IX and Henry III

summary.en: In 1259, King Louis IX of France and King Henry III of England signed the Treaty of Paris. Under its terms, Henry III renounced his claims to Normandy, Anjou, Poitou, and other territories, but retained Gascony (Aquitaine) as a fief of the French crown. Louis IX recognized Henry's rights to some border territories. The treaty ended the Angevin wars between England and France.

statement.en:
Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos of the Empire of Nicaea led his forces to recapture Constantinople, overthrowing the Latin Empire. Michael VIII was crowned Byzantine emperor, the patriarch of Constantinople was restored, and the Palaiologos dynasty began its rule of Byzantium (1261-1453). The last Latin emperor, Baldwin II, fled to western Europe. Although the Byzantine Empire was restored, it had lost much of its former power and territory.

For Europe in 1261, “Byzantine restoration” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Flourishing of the Republic of Siena

summary.en: In the 13th century, the Republic of Siena reached its peak of economic and cultural prosperity. Siena was one of Europe's most important financial centers; its bankers lent to popes and European monarchs. In 1297 Siena built the magnificent Palazzo Pubblico (Torre del Mangia, 102 m high). The Black Death of 1348 halved Siena's population, and the city declined thereafter.

statement.zh:
公元13世纪，意大利锡耶纳共和国达到经济和文化繁荣的顶峰。锡耶纳是欧洲最重要的金融中心之一，其银行家为教皇和欧洲各国君主提供贷款。1297年锡耶纳修建了宏伟的市政厅（曼贾塔楼高102米）。1348年黑死病使锡耶纳人口锐减一半，从此走向衰落。

statement.zh: 元世祖忽必烈下令在京师大都设立国子监，作为全国最高教育管理机构，同时将原金朝国子学扩建为正式学校。国子监教授蒙古、色目和汉族学生，教学内容包括儒家经典、蒙古文和骑射等。此举旨在培养忠于元朝的统治人才，也促进了不同民族文化的交流融合。
statement.en:
Emperor Kublai ordered the establishment of the Directorate of Imperial Academy (Guozijian) in the capital Dadu as the highest educational administration. The former Jin national academy was expanded into a proper school. The Guozijian taught Mongol, Semu, and Han Chinese students, covering Confucian classics, Mongolian language, archery and horsemanship. It aimed to cultivate ruling elites loyal to the Yuan and promote cultural exchange among ethnic groups.

For Asia in 1266, “Yuan establishes National Academy” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: Charles of Anjou, brother of King Louis IX of France, at the invitation of Pope Clement IV, led an army south into Italy and defeated Manfred of Hohenstaufen. Manfred was killed at the Battle of Benevento, and Charles was crowned King of Sicily. He then conquered Naples, establishing the Angevin dynasty there (1266-1282).

statement.zh:
法国国王路易九世的弟弟安茹的查理受教皇克莱孟四世之邀，率军南下意大利，击败了霍亨斯陶芬家族的曼弗雷迪。曼弗雷迪在贝内文托战役中阵亡，安茹的查理加冕为西西里国王。此后查理又征服了那不勒斯，建立了安茹王朝在那不勒斯和西西里的统治（1266-1282）。

1266年的那不勒斯王国，「安茹的查理征服西西里」属于政治领域。

title.en: Roger Bacon completes the Opus Majus

summary.en: In 1267 the English Franciscan Roger Bacon, writing at the private request of Pope Clement IV, produced the Opus Majus and, within two years, the Opus Minus and Opus Tertium, sending them to Rome. The Opus Majus is in seven parts, treating the causes of error, the relation of philosophy to theology, the study of languages, mathematics, optics, experimental science and moral phi

statement.zh: 1267年，英国方济各会士罗吉尔·培根应教皇克雷芒四世私下之请，在不到两年内接连写出《大著作》《小著作》《第三著作》并寄往罗马。
statement.en: In 1267 the English Franciscan Roger Bacon, writing at the private request of Pope Clement IV, produced the Opus Majus and, within two years, the Opus Minus and Opus Tertium, sending them to Rome.

zh: 1267年，英国方济各会士罗吉尔·培根应教皇克雷芒四世私下之请，在不到两年内接连写出《大著作》《小著作》《第三著作》并寄往罗马。
en: In 1267 the English Franciscan Roger Bacon, writing at the private request of Pope Clement IV, produced the Opus Majus and, within two years, the Opus Minus and Opus Tertium, sending them to Rome.

note.zh: 数字表述统一；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 《大著作》分七部，论哲学之弊、哲学与神学的关系、语言学习、数学、光学、实验科学与道德哲学，主张一切结论都须由经验与数学检验，是中世纪最早系统鼓吹实验方法的著作。
statement.en: The Opus Majus is in 7 parts, treating the causes of error, the relation of philosophy to theology, the study of languages, mathematics, optics, experimental science and moral philosophy, and insisting that every conclusion be tested by experience and mathematics—the first systematic medieval plea for the experimental method.

zh: 《大著作》分七部，论哲学之弊、哲学与神学的关系、语言学习、数学、光学、实验科学与道德哲学，主张一切结论都须由经验与数学检验，是中世纪最早系统鼓吹实验方法的著作。
en: The Opus Majus is in 7 parts, treating the causes of error, the relation of philosophy to theology, the study of languages, mathematics, optics, experimental science and moral philosophy, and insisting that every conclusion be tested by experience and mathematics—the first systematic medieval plea for the experimental method.

note.zh: 数字表述统一；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 培根在光学部分详论透镜成像与虹霓的成因，推测可磨制镜片以放大远物；他又据天文观测指出儒略历每约130年就差一日，力主改历——这一建议直到三个多世纪后的格里高利改历才被采纳。
statement.en: In the optical section Bacon discussed lenses and the causes of the rainbow and suggested that glass could be ground to magnify distant objects; from astronomical observation he showed that the Julian calendar gained a day about every 130 years and urged reform, advice acted on only with the Gregorian calendar 300 years later.

zh: 培根在光学部分详论透镜成像与虹霓的成因，推测可磨制镜片以放大远物；他又据天文观测指出儒略历每约130年就差一日，力主改历——这一建议直到三个多世纪后的格里高利改历才被采纳。
en: In the optical section Bacon discussed lenses and the causes of the rainbow and suggested that glass could be ground to magnify distant objects; from astronomical observation he showed that the Julian calendar gained a day about every 130 years and urged reform, advice acted on only with the Gregorian calendar 300 years later.

note.zh: 数字表述统一；事实待来源核验

statement.zh: 克雷芒四世1268年去世后培根失去庇护，晚年一度被本会禁闭。
statement.en: After Clement IV died in 1268 Bacon lost his protector and was later confined by his own order.

en: After Clement IV died in 1268 Bacon lost his protector and was later confined by his own order.

summary.en: Sent by Kublai as envoys to the pope, Niccolò and Maffeo Polo returned to Europe carrying letters from Kublai requesting the pope send a hundred missionaries to China. They arrived at Acre in 1269, learned that Pope Clement IV had died and a new pope had not yet been elected, so they returned to Venice to wait.

statement.zh:
尼科洛和马菲奥·波罗受忽必烈之命，作为使臣返回欧洲，携带忽必烈给教皇的书信，请求教皇派遣一百名传教士来中国传教。波罗兄弟于1269年抵达阿克里，得知教皇克莱孟四世已去世，新教皇尚未选出，他们于是返回威尼斯等待。

title.en: Sakya school becomes state religion of Yuan

summary.en: In 1269, Kublai Khan granted the title 'Imperial Preceptor' (Dishi) to the Sakya lama Drogön Chögyal Phagpa, making the Sakya school the state religion of the Yuan dynasty. Phagpa created the 'Phags-pa script' (Mongolian new script), which Kublai promulgated throughout the empire. With Yuan support, the Sakya school held both religious and political power in Tibet, establishing

statement.zh: 公元1269年，元世祖忽必烈封藏传佛教萨迦派高僧八思巴为"帝师"（大宝法王），萨迦派正式成为元朝的国教。
statement.en: In 1269, Kublai Khan granted the title 'Imperial Preceptor' (Dishi) to the Sakya lama Drogön Chögyal Phagpa, making the Sakya school the state religion of the Yuan dynasty.

summary.en: Yekuno Amlak of Ethiopia, with the support of the Christian church, overthrew the Zagwe dynasty and established the Solomonic dynasty. This dynasty claimed descent from the Queen of Sheba and King Solomon, restoring 'Solomonic blood' rule. The Solomonic dynasty ruled Ethiopia until 1974, making it the longest-reigning dynasty in African history.

summary.en: King Louis IX of France launched the Eighth Crusade, landing in Tunis, North Africa, in an attempt to force the Hafsid dynasty to convert to Christianity. However, plague struck the crusader army, and Louis himself died. His son Philip III succeeded and immediately withdrew. The Eighth Crusade ended in failure; it was the last major crusade of the Middle Ages.

statement.zh:
埃及马穆鲁克苏丹拜巴尔斯经长期围攻，攻占叙利亚山区阿萨辛派（尼扎里派）的核心堡垒马斯亚夫。该派以政治暗杀闻名，英文 assassin 一词即源出其名。此后拜巴尔斯逐一收取其余山寨，至1273年最后一座要塞卡赫夫投降，阿萨辛派作为独立政治力量就此消失，残余信众或转事马穆鲁克政权，或流散波斯与印度。

title.en: Return to Kaesong and the Sambyeolcho Revolt

summary.en: With the Choe regime gone the court submitted to the Yuan and returned to Kaesong; the elite Sambyeolcho refused, fighting on from Jindo and Jeju for four years.

statement.zh: 崔氏武人政权覆灭后王室降元还都，精锐三别抄拒不奉命，转战珍岛、耽罗，坚持抗元四年。还都意味着朝廷接受蒙古的约束，以保存王朝的名义放弃军事对抗；三别抄则以护卫王室的旧名义继续作战，从岛屿据点发动袭扰。两条路线的分歧，反映高丽在强敌压境时对存续方式的不同选择。抗元最终失败，但这段抵抗成为后世记忆的一部分。
statement.en: With the Choe regime gone the court submitted to the Yuan and returned to Kaesong; the elite Sambyeolcho refused, fighting on from Jindo and Jeju for four years.

summary.en: Kublai issued the 'Zhiyuan Xinge', the first codified law of the Yuan dynasty, consisting of 20 chapters covering official ranks, households and marriage, finance, and penal law. 忽必烈颁布《至元新格》，这是元朝第一部成文法典，共20篇，包括职制、户婚、钱谷、刑律等内容。《至元新格》融合了蒙古习惯法和中原法律传统，是元朝法律体系的基础。条文以断例与格令汇编，兼顾草原旧俗与汉地律令；官府的断案与征税由此有章可循。

statement.zh:
1273年12月6日弥撒之后，阿奎那忽然停止口授，对秘书雷金纳德说“较之我所见者，我所写的一切都如同稻草”，此后再未续写，《神学大全》第三部终成残篇，由弟子辑其旧作补成“补编”。次年他应召赴里昂大公会议，途中病逝于福萨诺瓦修道院。1323年被教宗若望二十二世列为圣人，后世尊称“天使博士”。

1273年的教皇国，「阿奎那停笔《神学大全》」属于宗教领域。
statement.en:
After mass on 6 December 1273 Aquinas abruptly stopped dictating, telling his secretary Reginald that 'compared with what I have seen, all I have written seems like straw'. He never resumed, leaving the 3th part of the Summa unfinished; his pupils assembled a supplement from his earlier writings. Summoned to the Council of Lyon the following year, he died on the way at Fossanova abbey. He was canonised by John XXII in 1323 and is known as the Angelic Doctor.

In 1273, “Aquinas lays down the Summa Theologiae” belongs to the field of Religion in Europe.

For Europe in 1273, “Aquinas lays down the Summa Theologiae” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Franciscans allowed to preach in Beijing

summary.en: In 1274 (the 11th year of Zhiyuan), Kublai Khan allowed Italian Franciscan friars to establish churches and preach in Dadu (Beijing). Previously, Kublai had sent envoys to Rome, and Pope Gregory X sent Franciscans like John of Montecorvino back to the Yuan court. The Franciscans built a church in Dadu and translated some Christian texts, coexisting with Nestorian Christianity.

statement.zh: 元至元11年（1274年），元世祖忽必烈批准意大利方济各会修士在北京（大都）建立教堂和传教。此前忽必烈派遣的使臣曾前往罗马谒见教皇，教皇格里高利十世派遣柏朗嘉宾等方济各会修士回访元朝。方济各会在大都建造了教堂并翻译了部分基督教经文，与景教（聂斯托利派）共存。这是天主教首次正式进入中国内地传教。
statement.en:
In 1274 (the 11th year of Zhiyuan), Kublai Khan allowed Italian Franciscan friars to establish churches and preach in Dadu (Beijing). Previously, Kublai had sent envoys to Rome, and Pope Gregory X sent Franciscans like John of Montecorvino back to the Yuan court. The Franciscans built a church in Dadu and translated some Christian texts, coexisting with Nestorian Christianity. This was the first time Catholicism was formally allowed to spread in China's interior.

For Asia in 1274, “Franciscans allowed to preach in Beijing” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 元至元11年（1274年），元世祖忽必烈批准意大利方济各会修士在北京（大都）建立教堂和传教。此前忽必烈派遣的使臣曾前往罗马谒见教皇，教皇格里高利十世派遣柏朗嘉宾等方济各会修士回访元朝。方济各会在大都建造了教堂并翻译了部分基督教经文，与景教（聂斯托利派）共存。这是天主教首次正式进入中国内地传教。
元至元11年（1274年），元世祖忽必烈批准意大利方济各会修士在北京（大都）建立教堂和传教。
en: In 1274 (the 11th year of Zhiyuan), Kublai Khan allowed Italian Franciscan friars to establish churches and preach in Dadu (Beijing). Previously, Kublai had sent envoys to Rome, and Pope Gregory X sent Franciscans like John of Montecorvino back to the Yuan court. The Franciscans built a church in Dadu and translated some Christian texts, coexisting with Nestorian Christianity. This was the first time Catholicism was formally allowed to spread in China's interior.

After the fall of Lin'an, loyal officials Wen Tianxiang, Lu Xiufu, and Zhang Shijie proclaimed the elder brother of Emperor Gong, Zhao Shi, as emperor in Fuzhou, known as Emperor Duanzong. title.en: Yuan establishes Penghu Patrol and Inspection Office

summary.en: In 1278 (the 15th year of Zhiyuan), the Yuan dynasty established a Patrol and Inspection Office in the Penghu Islands, under the jurisdiction of Tong'an County, Quanzhou Route, Fujian Province. The office was the first formal administrative institution set up by the Yuan in the Taiwan Strait, responsible for managing merchant shipping, maintaining sea lane safety, and collectin

statement.zh: 元世祖至元15年（1278年），元朝在澎湖群岛设立巡检司，隶属福建行省泉州路同安县。澎湖巡检司是元朝在台湾海峡设置的首个正式行政机构，主要负责管理商船通行、维护航道安全、征收船舶税。巡检司的设立标志着中国中央政府首次对澎湖地区进行正式行政管理，为后来明清两朝对台澎地区的管辖提供了先例。
statement.en:
In 1278 (the 15th year of Zhiyuan), the Yuan dynasty established a Patrol and Inspection Office in the Penghu Islands, under the jurisdiction of Tong'an County, Quanzhou Route, Fujian Province. The office was the first formal administrative institution set up by the Yuan in the Taiwan Strait, responsible for managing merchant shipping, maintaining sea lane safety, and collecting shipping taxes. Its establishment marked the first time the Chinese central government had formally administered the Penghu area, setting a precedent for the Qing and Ming dynasties' governance of the Taiwan-Penghu region.

For Asia in 1278, “Yuan establishes Penghu Patrol and Inspection Office” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 元将张弘范率水军与南宋流亡朝廷的最后一支水军，在崖山（今广东江门新会）海域决战。南宋水军统帅张世杰将千余艘战船用铁索相连结成水寨，元军采用火攻和突袭战术，切断宋军补给。宋军力战不支，陆秀夫见大势已去，先驱妻儿投海，然后背负年仅8岁的宋末帝赵昺投海殉国。张世杰突围后遇台风殉职，十数万军民蹈海而死。崖山海战标志着南宋灭亡，古典中华文明遭遇重大断裂。
statement.en:
The Yuan naval commander Zhang Hongfan engaged the last naval forces of the Southern Song exiled court at Yamen (present-day Xinhui, Jiangmen, Guangdong). The Song commander Zhang Shijie linked his thousand-plus ships with iron chains to form a water fortress; the Yuan used fire attacks and surprise tactics to cut off Song supplies. The Song fought stubbornly but were overwhelmed. Seeing the situation hopeless, Lu Xiufu first drove his wife and children into the sea, then carried the eight-year-old Last Emperor Zhao Bing and jumped into the sea, drowning. Zhang Shijie also died in a typhoon after breaking out. 10,000 of Song officials, soldiers, and civilians perished. The Battle of Yamen marked the fall of the Southern Song and a major rupture in classical Chinese civilization.

For Asia in 1279, “Battle of Yamen” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Polynesians settle Aotearoa and Maori culture takes shape

summary.en: Radiocarbon dates, tephra layers and the bones of the Pacific rat that travelled with people all place the arrival of Polynesian voyagers in Aotearoa (New Zealand) at about 1250-1300, making it the last large landmass on earth to be settled. Maori tradition names the navigator Kupe as its discoverer and remembers the canoes of a migration fleet, each tribe (iwi) tracing itself

statement.zh: 放射性碳测年、火山灰层序与随人迁徙的波利尼西亚鼠骨证据一致显示。波利尼西亚航海者约在1250—1300年间自东波利尼西亚（社会群岛一带）驾双体独木舟抵达奥特亚罗瓦（新西兰），这是人类定居的最后一片大型陆地。毛利口传以航海家库佩为发现者，并追述"迁徙船队"诸舟之名，各部族（iwi）皆自述所出之舟。移民以猎取不会飞的巨鸟恐鸟、捕捞海豹和栽培自热带带来的甘薯（kūmara）为生；约两百年间恐鸟与哈斯特鹰相继灭绝。人口转向园圃农业与渔猎，并发展出以山堡（pā）、木雕、绿玉器和纹面（tā moko）为标志的毛利文化。
statement.en: Radiocarbon dates, tephra layers and the bones of the Pacific rat that travelled with people all place the arrival of Polynesian voyagers in Aotearoa (New Zealand) at about 1250-1300, making it the last large landmass on earth to be settled. Maori tradition names the navigator Kupe as its discoverer and remembers the canoes of a migration fleet, each tribe (iwi) tracing itself to one of them. The settlers lived by hunting the flightless moa, taking seals and growing the sweet potato (kumara) brought from the tropics; within some 200 years the moa and the Haast's eagle were extinct and the population turned to horticulture and fishing, developing the fortified pa, the wood carving. Greenstone work and facial tattooing (ta moko) that define Maori culture.

Maori tradition names the navigator Kupe as its discoverer and remembers the canoes of a migration fleet, each tribe (iwi) tracing itself to one of them. The settlers lived by hunting the flightless moa, taking seals and growing the sweet potato (kumara) brought from the tropics; within some 200 years the moa and the Haast's eagle were extinct and the population turned to horticulture and fishing, developing the fortified pa, the wood carving. Greenstone work and facial tattooing (ta moko) that define Maori culture.

statement.en: Kublai launched a second invasion of Japan, sending two armies: an Eastern Route army of 40,000 from Korea and a Southern Route (Jiangnan) army of 100,000 from Ningbo, totaling about 140,000 troops.

sources.excerpt: The second Mongol fleet was much larger, made up of two separate forces—one setting out from Masan (Korea) and the other sailing from southern China—with a combined force of 4,400 vessels and some 140,000 soldiers and sailors. The two fleets joined up near Hakata Bay, again the main point of attack, on Aug. 12, 1281. On August 15 ... a massive typhoon hit, wrecking the Mongol fleet ... at least half the Mongol warriors drowning and all but a few hundred ships from the fleet perishing during the storm.

title.en: Dante meets Beatrice again in the streets of Florence

summary.en: In 1283 the eighteen-year-old Dante met Beatrice Portinari again in the streets of Florence and received her greeting for the first time. According to the Vita Nuova their first meeting had been at a May Day feast in 1274, when Dante was nine and Beatrice eight. statement.zh:
1283年，十八岁的但丁在佛罗伦萨街头再次遇见贝雅特丽齐·波尔蒂纳里，并第一次得到她的问候致意。据《新生》记载，两人初见是在1274年的五月节筵席上，当时但丁九岁、贝雅特丽齐八岁。1283年的这一次致意令但丁心醉神迷，成为《新生》全书的起点。贝雅特丽齐后嫁与银行家西莫内·代·巴尔迪，1290年早逝，年仅24岁；但丁此后在《新生》与《神曲》中把她升华为引导灵魂穿越天堂的象征。

1283年的佛罗伦萨，「但丁在佛罗伦萨街头再遇贝雅特丽齐」属于文学领域。
statement.en:
In 1283 the eighteen-year-old Dante met Beatrice Portinari again in the streets of Florence and received her greeting for the first time. According to the Vita Nuova their first meeting had been at a May Day feast in 1274, when Dante was nine and Beatrice eight. The greeting of 1283 left him enraptured and became the starting point of the Vita Nuova. Beatrice later married the banker Simone de' Bardi and died in 1290 at only 24; Dante went on to transfigure her in the Vita Nuova and the Divine Comedy into the guide who leads the soul through paradise.

In 1283, “Dante meets Beatrice again in the streets of Florence” belongs to the field of Literature in Europe.

statement.en:
Kublai sent Prince Toghan (his ninth son) to lead an army against Annam (present-day northern Vietnam). The Yuan captured the Annamese capital Thang Long (present-day Hanoi), but the Annamese king Trần Nhật Duật, with the help of the famous general Trần Hưng Đạo (Prince Hưng Đạo), used scorched-earth and guerrilla tactics. The Yuan army was forced to withdraw due to lack of supplies and plague. The Yuan-Vietnam war continued until 1288, when Annam eventually agreed to pay tribute to the Yuan.

For Asia in 1284, “Yuan campaign against Annam” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Yuan establishes Regional Censorate in Jiangnan

summary.en: Kublai established a Regional Censorate in Jiangnan (south of the Yangtze), alongside the existing Censorate in Dadu. summary.en: William of Ockham (c. 1287-1347) held that entities should not be multiplied beyond necessity (Ockham's razor) and used logical parsimony against realism, pushing scholastic thought toward simplicity.

statement.zh: 奥卡姆的威廉（约1287—1347）主张“如无必要勿增实体”（奥卡姆剃刀），以逻辑简约批判实在论，推动经院哲学由繁复走向化简。他把共相之争引向语言与指称的分析，认为多余的概念应被削去；这一方法后来影响科学思维与哲学论证。经院哲学由此转向更严格的分析。

statement.zh: 元世祖至元24年（1287年），元朝正式设立云南行省，治所设在中庆（今昆明），下辖路、府、州、县各级行政单位。此前云南主要由大理国和善阐等地方政权控制，1253年忽必烈平定大理后设立了云南等处行中书省。行省的建立强化了中央政府对云南边疆的控制，推动了汉族移民进入云南，促进了当地经济开发和各族群的文化交流。
statement.en:
In 1287 (the 24th year of Zhiyuan), the Yuan dynasty formally established Yunnan Province, with its capital at Zhongqing (present-day Kunming), and governed through routes, prefectures, counties, and other administrative units. Before this, Yunnan was mainly controlled by the Dali kingdom and local chieftains. After Kublai pacified Dali in 1253, the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was set up. The establishment of the province strengthened central government control over the Yunnan frontier, promoted Han Chinese migration into Yunnan, and facilitated economic development and cultural exchange among ethnic groups.

For Asia in 1287, “Yunnan Province established” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Yuan builds Altars of Soil and Grain

summary.en: Kublai built altars for the gods of soil and grain in the southern suburbs of Dadu, following Han custom to worship the gods of earth and grain. This move marked the Yuan rulers' further acceptance of traditional Central Plains ritual culture, helping to ease Han-Mongol ethnic tensions.

statement.zh: 忽必烈在大都南郊修建社稷坛，按照汉制祭祀后土神和五谷神。这一举措标志着元朝统治者进一步接受了中原传统的礼制文化，有助于缓和汉蒙民族矛盾。祭祀以农本为义，把王朝的合法性系于土地与收成；蒙古贵族参与汉礼，制度与习俗逐步交融。象征性的礼仪服务现实的政治。
statement.en: Kublai Khan built the Sheji Altar in the southern suburbs of Dadu to worship the earth god and the grain god according to the Han system.

statement.zh:
乌里、施维茨和下瓦尔登三个森林州在琉森湖畔的吕特利草地宣誓结盟，签署《永久同盟宪章》。盟约规定三州在遭受攻击时互相援助，共同维护自治权利，并承诺不使用外国法官。1291年因此被公认为瑞士联邦的建国之年。瑞士联邦此后逐步扩大，成为永久中立国。

title.en: Scottish War of Independence breaks out

summary.en: After Edward I deposed John Balliol, Scottish nobles rose up against English rule. Edward I led an army into Scotland, capturing the southern border towns. The Scots sought help from France, forming the 'Auld Alliance' (1295) against England. The First War of Scottish Independence officially began (1296-1328).

statement.zh:

summary.en: In 1293, the Republic of Florence minted the first gold florin. Each florin contained about 3.5 grams of fine gold (24 karat) and was about 19 mm in diameter. The florin quickly became the standard currency for international trade in Europe, trusted for its stable purity. The issuance of the florin solidified Florence's position as a financial center in Europe.

statement.zh:
公元1293年，佛罗伦萨共和国铸造发行了佛罗林金币（Florin）。每枚佛罗林金币含金量约3.5克（24K纯度），直径约19毫米。佛罗林迅速成为欧洲国际贸易的标准货币，因其纯度稳定而广受信赖。佛罗林的发行巩固了佛罗伦萨作为欧洲金融中心的地位。

1293年的佛罗伦萨，「佛罗伦萨铸币厂发行佛罗林金币」属于经济领域。
statement.en: In 1293, the Republic of Florence minted the first gold florin.

summary.en: Venice and Genoa clash again over Black Sea trade privileges, beginning the Second Venetian-Genoese War (War of Curzola), ended by the Treaty of Milan in 1299.

statement.zh:
威尼斯与热那亚因黑海贸易特权再起冲突，第二次威尼斯—热那亚战争（库尔佐拉战争）爆发，至1299年签订《米兰和约》结束。

title.en: Marriage alliance between Yuan and Ilkhanate

summary.en: In the first year of Yuanzhen (1295), the Yuan dynasty and the Ilkhanate reinforced their suzerain-vassal relationship through marriage. Emperor Chengzong Temür gave a Mongol princess in marriage to Ilkhan Ghazan, recognizing Ghazan as the legitimate Ilkhan. Ghazan (r. 1295-1304) converted to Islam and carried out reforms, but maintained a tributary relationship with the Yuan.

statement.zh: 元贞元年（1295年），元朝与伊儿汗国通过联姻巩固宗藩关系。元成宗铁穆耳将一位蒙古公主嫁给伊儿汗合赞（Ghazan），承认合赞为伊儿汗的正统。合赞在位期间（1295-1304年）皈依伊斯兰教并推行改革，但仍保持与元朝的朝贡关系。元朝与伊儿汗国的联盟确保了丝绸之路北线的安全，使东西方之间的贸易和使节往来频繁。马可·波罗等旅行者正是通过这条通道往来于欧亚之间。

statement.zh: 黄道婆早年流落海南崖州，向黎族学得棉纺织技艺，元贞年间返回故里松江乌泥泾。她改造出踏车去籽、椎弓弹棉与三锭脚踏纺车，并传授错纱配色、综线挈花的织造法，使松江棉布行销全国，时有“衣被天下”之称。
statement.en:
Huang Daopo had spent her early years in Yazhou on Hainan, where she learned cotton working from the Li people, and returned to her home village of Wunijing in Songjiang during the Yuanzhen era. She introduced a geared gin for removing seeds, a large bow for fluffing the fibre and a treadle spinning wheel with three spindles, and taught methods of colour-mixing and patterned weaving. Songjiang cotton cloth was soon sold across the empire and was said to 'clothe all under heaven'.

For Asia in 1295, “Huang Daopo revolutionizes cotton textile” is a traceable node of Agriculture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Zhou Daguan visits Angkor and writes his record

summary.en: Yuan envoy Zhou Daguan visits Cambodia and writes the Records of Cambodia, a key account of Angkor's city, faith and life.

statement.zh:
元代周达观随使赴真腊（柬埔寨），归著《真腊风土记》，详尽记录吴哥时期柬埔寨的城郭、信仰与民俗。他随使团经海路抵达，在都城停留多时，观察王宫、寺庙、市集与节庆，并记当地语言、货币与风俗。书中对吴哥的描写成为后世研究的重要依据。

把「周达观使真腊著风土记」放回1296年的中南半岛，可以看到探索变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: During the Yuan Dynasty, Zhou Daguan went to Chenla (Cambodia) with his envoy and wrote "Chenla Customs", which recorded in detail the city walls, beliefs and folk customs of Cambodia during the Angkor period.

summary.en: King Philip IV of France took advantage of Count Guy of Dampierre's alliance with England to invade Flanders. The French army faced resistance from Flemish militias near Kortrijk, but ultimately gained control of the main Flemish cities. The textile-producing cities of Bruges, Ghent, and Ypres were forced to accept French rule.

statement.zh:
法国国王腓力四世趁佛兰德斯伯爵居伊·当皮埃尔与英格兰结盟之机，派军入侵佛兰德斯。法军在弗兰德地区的科特赖克附近遭遇佛兰德斯民兵抵抗，但最终控制了佛兰德斯的主要城市。佛兰德斯毛纺织业城市（布鲁日、根特、伊普尔）被迫接受法国的统治。

1297年的法国，「法兰西吞并佛兰德斯」属于军事领域。

summary.en: In 1297, after defeating the English garrison at Lanark, Scottish hero William Wallace was formally knighted by Scottish nobles near Selkirk Forest and elected 'Guardian of Scotland'. In September of that year, Wallace defeated the English army at Stirling Bridge. However, Wallace was defeated by Edward I at Falkirk in 1298, captured in 1305, and executed.

statement.zh: 马可·波罗在热那亚监狱中口述的《马可·波罗游记》完成。这本书分为4卷，详细记述了马可·波罗在中国、东南亚、印度和波斯的见闻，特别是对元朝忽必烈的宫廷、大都（北京）、杭州、泉州等城市的描述令欧洲人叹为观止。书中关于中国富庶和文明的记载，后来刺激了哥伦布等探险家寻找通往东方的新航路。
statement.en:
Marco Polo's dictation in a Genoese prison was completed as 'The Travels of Marco Polo'. The book, divided into 4 volumes, gives a detailed account of Marco Polo's travels in China, Southeast Asia, India, and Persia, with particularly stunning descriptions of Kublai's court, Dadu (Beijing), Hangzhou, Quanzhou, and other cities. The accounts of China's wealth and civilization later inspired explorers like Columbus to seek new sea routes to the East.

For Europe in 1298, “'Travels of Marco Polo' completed” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.en: Traditional chronology treats 1299 as the starting point of the Ottoman state. The more defensible account is that Osman led ghazi raids on the Bithynian frontier at the end of the 13th century and by about 1300 controlled an area from Eskişehir to the plain of İznik. This was not an empire built overnight but a frontier polity left by the collapse of Seljuq power, Mongol overl

statement.zh: 传统纪年把1299年当作奥斯曼国家的起点。这个年份来自后世王朝叙事；同时代材料更常把奥斯曼描述为13世纪末比提尼亚边境上的一支加齐（ghazi）力量。
statement.en: Traditional chronology treats 1299 as the starting point of the Ottoman state. The year comes from later dynastic narrative; contemporary evidence more often describes Osman as a ghazi commander on the Bithynian frontier at the end of the 13th century.

sources.locator: Britannica, Ottoman Empire, section 'Origins and expansion of the Ottoman state, c. 1300–1402', opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: The Ottoman Empire began at the very end of the 13th century with a series of raids from Turkic warriors (known as ghazis) led by Osman I, a prince (bey) whose father, Ertugrul, had established a power base in Söğüt (near Bursa, Turkey).

zh: 传统纪年把1299年当作奥斯曼国家的起点。这个年份来自后世王朝叙事；同时代材料更常把奥斯曼描述为13世纪末比提尼亚边境上的一支加齐（ghazi）力量。
en: Traditional chronology treats 1299 as the starting point of the Ottoman state. The year comes from later dynastic narrative; contemporary evidence more often describes Osman as a ghazi commander on the Bithynian frontier at the end of the 13th century.

note.zh: 1299 为后世王朝纪年；来源只支持13世纪末与约1300年，不把建国写成单日事件。
note.en: 1299 is a later dynastic date; the source supports only the end of the 13th century and about 1300, not a single-day foundation.

statement.zh: 蒙古在1293年最终击败塞尔柱之后，安纳托利亚出现多个独立的突厥贝伊国。奥斯曼是其中之一，他以瑟于特为基地，向拜占庭的比提尼亚边境发动袭掠。
statement.en: After the Mongols finally defeated the Seljuqs in 1293, several independent Turkmen principalities appeared in Anatolia. Osman was one of them; based at Söğüt, he raided the Byzantine frontier in Bithynia.

sources.locator: Britannica, Ottoman Empire, section 'Origins and expansion of the Ottoman state, c. 1300–1402', paragraph 1
sources.excerpt: Following the final Mongol defeat of the Seljuqs in 1293, Osman emerged as prince (bey) of the border principality that took over Byzantine Bithynia in northwestern Anatolia.

zh: 蒙古在1293年最终击败塞尔柱之后，安纳托利亚出现多个独立的突厥贝伊国。奥斯曼是其中之一，他以瑟于特为基地，向拜占庭的比提尼亚边境发动袭掠。
en: After the Mongols finally defeated the Seljuqs in 1293, several independent Turkmen principalities appeared in Anatolia. Osman was one of them; based at Söğüt, he raided the Byzantine frontier in Bithynia.

note.zh: 不写卡拉贾希萨尔、罗姆苏丹国宗主权等来源未支持的细节。
note.en: No Karacahisar or Seljuk suzerainty detail is added; the source does not support it.

statement.zh: 到1300年前后，奥斯曼已控制从埃斯基谢希尔到伊兹尼克平原的一片地区，并数次击退拜占庭组织的围剿。此时他仍是一个边境贝伊，不是统辖欧亚的帝国苏丹。
statement.en: By about 1300 Osman controlled an area from Eskişehir to the plain of İznik and had beaten several Byzantine attempts to curb him. He was still a frontier bey, not an emperor ruling Eurasia.

sources.locator: Britannica, Ottoman Empire, section 'Origins and expansion of the Ottoman state, c. 1300–1402', paragraph 2
sources.excerpt: By 1300 Osman ruled an area in Anatolia stretching from Eskişehir (Dorylaeum) to the plains of İznik (Nicaea), having defeated several organized Byzantine efforts to curb his expansion.

zh: 到1300年前后，奥斯曼已控制从埃斯基谢希尔到伊兹尼克平原的一片地区，并数次击退拜占庭组织的围剿。此时他仍是一个边境贝伊，不是统辖欧亚的帝国苏丹。
en: By about 1300 Osman controlled an area from Eskişehir to the plain of İznik and had beaten several Byzantine attempts to curb him. He was still a frontier bey, not an emperor ruling Eurasia.

note.zh: 地理范围按来源写，不扩展为“整个安纳托利亚”。
note.en: The geographic claim follows the source and is not inflated to all of Anatolia.

statement.zh: 所以，1299年的意义不在“宣布独立”这种戏剧性动作，而在一个长期过程：边境战争、移民流入与拜占庭内乱，把一个小贝伊国推上了历史舞台。
statement.en: The significance of 1299 lies less in a dramatic declaration of independence than in a long process: frontier war, migration and Byzantine civil strife pushed a small principality onto the historical stage.

zh: 所以，1299年的意义不在“宣布独立”这种戏剧性动作，而在一个长期过程：边境战争、移民流入与拜占庭内乱，把一个小贝伊国推上了历史舞台。
en: The significance of 1299 lies less in a dramatic declaration of independence than in a long process: frontier war, migration and Byzantine civil strife pushed a small principality onto the historical stage.

note.zh: 作者判断：反对“单日建国”叙事。
note.en: Author judgment: rejects the single-day foundation narrative.

title.en: Chimú Empire on the north Peruvian coast

summary.en: The Chimú centered at Chan Chan on the north coast, famed for vast adobe cities, hydraulic works and goldwork, until conquered by the Inca in the 15th century.

statement.zh: 奇穆沿秘鲁北岸建都昌昌，以大规模土坯城、水利与金饰工艺称雄，直至15世纪被印加征服。昌昌以土坯砌筑的宫殿与院落分区，城墙、蓄水池与渠道支撑着沿海的灌溉农业；金工与织物工艺显示出手工业的专业化。奇穆的行政与工程能力后来部分被印加吸收，其沿海传统与高地帝国形成对照。
statement.en: Chimu built its capital in Changchang along the northern coast of Peru and dominated with its large-scale adobe city, water conservancy and gold jewelry craftsmanship until it was conquered by the Incas in the 15th century.

title.en: Three-field system fully replaces two-field system in Europe

summary.en: Around 1300, European peasants widely adopted the three-field system, dividing arable land into spring-sown, autumn-sown, and fallow sections rotated annually. This system increased agricultural output by about 33% compared to the two-field system, reducing fallow time. Its spread was a core element of the medieval agricultural revolution, providing the food base for population

statement.zh:
约公元1300年，欧洲农民广泛采用三圃轮作制（Three-field system），将耕地分为春播、秋播和休耕三部分轮流使用。这一制度比传统的二圃制提高了约33%的农业产出，减少了休耕时间。三圃制的推广是中世纪农业革命的核心内容之一，为欧洲人口增长和城市复兴提供了粮食基础。

title.en: Wang Shifu writes The Romance of the Western Chamber

summary.en: Yuan-dynasty playwright Wang Shifu composes The Romance of the Western Chamber, telling the love story of Zhang Sheng and Cui Yingying, hailed as a pinnacle of classical Chinese drama.

statement.zh: 元代杂剧家王实甫创作《西厢记》，写张生与崔莺莺爱情故事，被誉为中国古典戏曲的巅峰之作。剧作把爱情的自主与礼教的约束放在冲突之中，以红娘的机智推动情节，唱词兼具文采与口语的生动；人物心理的细腻刻画，使戏曲从叙事走向情感的深入。作品在后世舞台上不断改编，成为戏曲与文学的共同经典。

title.en: Timbuktu becomes a centre of learning

summary.en: Under the Mali empire Timbuktu grew into a West African centre of Islamic learning and trade; its Sankore university drew scholars, and its books and caravans made it famed across the Mediterranean world.

statement.zh:
廷巴克图在马里帝国治下发展为西非的伊斯兰学术与贸易中心，桑科雷大学汇聚学者，藏书与商队使之名扬地中海世界。跨撒哈拉商路把黄金、盐与书籍带入城市，学者以手抄本与讲授传播知识；清真寺与学院构成学术网络。商业财富支撑了文化与宗教生活。

把「廷巴克图成为学术中心」放回1300年的马里，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。

summary.en: The Hopi built multi-story stone-and-adobe villages in Arizona, sustaining dryland maize cultivation and kachina belief as a living continuous tradition.

statement.zh:
霍皮人在今亚利桑那以石与土坯筑成多层村落，延续旱作玉米栽培与克奇纳信仰，是北美原住民连续居住的活传统。村落建于台地，以石墙与土坯砌筑，屋顶与院落层层相连；旱作依靠雨水与少量灌溉，克奇纳仪式贯穿年周期。

把「霍皮人营造石屋村落」放回1300年的北美西南，可以看到社会变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The Hopi built multi-story villages of stone and adobe in what is now Arizona, continuing dry corn cultivation and the Kachina belief.

1300年的新西兰，「毛利人定居新西兰」属于社会领域。

summary.en: Jiaxing artisans Zhang Cheng and Yang Mao excelled at tihong, many layers of carved red lacquer with rounded, full-bodied designs, setting a standard for later lacquer.

statement.zh: 嘉兴张成、杨茂以层层髹漆雕刻的剔红闻名，纹样浑厚、刀法圆润，为后世漆器典范。剔红先在胎体上反复涂漆，积至相当厚度再行雕刻，花纹与漆层深浅相应，形成浮雕般的效果；张成、杨茂的作品以花卉与人物见长，刀口隐起而轮廓饱满。其风格经学徒与后辈延续，成为元明漆艺的重要传统。
